reason: I do not know these partners and I cannot see any real reviews yet. I already have a workshop I have gone to for years and I bargain with them face to face, so I will not hand SAR 1,300 to 2,100 to a name I have never met.
objection: Who are these people, and if the film goes on badly I will still be the one standing in the workshop with my car. The money being held helps, but I still have to trust the man who touches my car.
would_change_my_mind: A real review from a car owner I know, or my own workshop listed on the app.
